items.name: Mohamed Hassan
items.text: Meksova is a great app and super easy to use. It keeps all your receipts in one place, which makes tracking expenses and dealing with the IRS stress-free. I highly recommend it!

items.name: Selam
items.text: Meksova has completely changed how we manage our grocery store finances. Recording daily sales, supplier payments, and expenses used to take hours, but now everything is simple and organized in one place.

items.name: Dawit Bekele
items.text: Running a restaurant means hundreds of expenses daily. Meksova keeps it all under control. The receipt scanner saves me two hours every week. Worth every penny.

items.name: Fatuma Ali
items.text: I was drowning in paperwork before Meksova. Now my boutique's financials are always up to date. Tax season is no longer a nightmare. This app is a lifesaver for any small business owner.

items.name: Yonas Girma
items.text: Simple, clean, and incredibly efficient. I manage three stores and meksova lets me keep everything separate and clear. The reporting feature is especially useful.

items.name: Hana Mekonnen
items.text: Finally an app that understands the needs of small businesses. The interface is intuitive and the support team is incredibly responsive. Meksova has made bookkeeping something I no longer dread.

meta.title: Nosotros - Meksova
meta.description: Conozca Meksova y nuestra contabilidad simple.

story.text: meksova was born out of our own struggles with managing and recording financial transactions accurately and efficiently. After facing challenges in handling our finances, we realized the need for a robust, automated solution. That's when we created meksova — a system designed to streamline and simplify the process of financial transaction recording. meksova leverages automation to seamlessly track and record every transaction in your day-to-day operations, transforming the way you manage your business finances. Our platform offers professional, easy-to-understand reports like journal entries, income statements, and balance sheets, ensuring that your financial data is always organized and accessible. Our system is tailored to help businesses address common financial challenges, providing clear insights into where your business stands at any given time. With tools to track daily transactions and analyze your financial data, meksova empowers you to implement short and long-term strategies, optimizing business growth and success. Let meksova help you take control of your financial future with ease and confidence.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy for meksova
privacy.intro: At meksova, we are committed to protecting and respecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal and financial information when you use our website and services ("the Service"). By using meksova, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
paragraphs: We collect two types of information:

list.label: Personal Information:
list.text: Information that can be used to identify you personally, such as your name, email address, phone number, and billing information.

list.label: Transactional and Financial Data:
list.text: Information related to your use of the Service, including transaction records, receipts, account balances, income, expenses, and other financial information you input into the system.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
paragraphs: meksova uses the information we collect in the following ways:

list.label: To Provide the Service:
list.text: To process and record your transactions, generate financial reports, and offer summaries of your financial data.

list.label: To Improve the Service:

list.label: To Communicate with You:

list.label: To Comply with Legal Obligations:
list.text: To comply with applicable laws, regulations, and legal processes.

sections.title: 3. Data Security
paragraphs: We implement reasonable administrative, technical, and physical measures to protect your personal and financial data. However, no system can guarantee 100% security. While we strive to protect your information, we cannot guarantee the absolute security of data transmitted to or from the Service.

sections.title: 4. Data Retention

list.label: Service Providers:

sections.title: 7. Cookies and Tracking Technologies

sections.title: 8. Your Rights and Choices
